en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem with the submission of the advance payment regarding the animals, when its age has been described’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Advance payment to buy an animal is not unlawful if the age of animals is clearly described.’”
